title: World Bloom — Dear My Fellows — Episode5 Renewed Resolve

meta.Event Outline: Having trained with three famous troupes, Wonderlands×Showtime has certainly grown. While checking for any changes in their SEKAI, they hear of a problem with the tree, and are shown a world where they are each chasing their own dreams.

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you very much for agreeing to work with me on those things, Mr. Kijima!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On top of that fight, you even stayed to coach me as I practiced on my own. I really appreciate the help.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Not a problem! I understand exactly how you feel since I also want to do everything I can to put on a great show.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Plus, we're both playing leads this time around, so we'll need to work in perfect sync.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Very true... “Ishin-den”, the tale of two brothers separated at a young age who end up facing off as supporters of the new government and old shogunate.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The climax involves an epic sword fight that will likely make or break the entire show. I'm incredibly excited about that scene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I still get the feeling that we can do more to make it even better...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I wish I could be more specific.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
No, you don't need to apologize.
It's important to keep searching for new ideas!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
That being said...
You have to find the answer you're looking for on your own.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: And when you do, I have a feeling that you're going to grow more than you have until now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
More than I have until now...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay...
I, Tsukasa Tenma, promise to find the answer!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! That's what I like to hear!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Tenma, have you replied to that message already?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What message?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: The one you received while we were practicing. You said it was from your old friends.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You started practicing on your own right after that, so I was wondering if you'd replied already.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, you're right...!
I'd become so focused on practicing that I completely forgot...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll reply right now!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Ah, I'm glad that you remembered!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Still, you must all be pretty close to keep in contact like this after disbanding your troupe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The truth is, part of why I decided to go train overseas is because one of them inspired me...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I received word the other day that he will be joining a top-level troupe in the United States as he pursues his dream.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I felt that I couldn't let him hog all the glory.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know that I still need a lot of work, and that it's far too soon for me to go train abroad. But...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't want to sit idly by as my friends move forward towards their dreams... Chiefly because I am the troupe leader of Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have to be an example by fulfilling my dream and becoming a star who makes the whole world smile!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
I see...
I like that. It's very you, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You're always heading straight towards your dream!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
So, keep running.
Go become a big star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Mr. Kijima...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you! I will!

I'm sure you can.
Aren't you a future star that will bring joy to everyone?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Who said that just now...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I have no idea, but it felt like they were trying to give me words of encouragement...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This is it. My last show...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I have to do my best to make sure I don't fall behind them...!)
One week later
Shrine Grounds

rows.Speaker: Rokuro
rows.Line: “No, what are you doing here...?!”

rows.Speaker: Rokuro
rows.Line: “I gave you your chance to flee!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Okay, my timing was perfect!
Next, we'll go from our swords being locked to a series of parries.)
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Wow!
Did you see that guy's wall jump...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(He's improvising...!
Okay, I'll get pushed back here, and take up a defensive posture.)

rows.Speaker: Kansuke
rows.Line: “R-Rokuro...!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Wow, this scene's so amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The audience seems to really be enjoying this. Alright, next, I'll...)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member C
rows.Line:
No, I should be the one apologizing...
I wasn't expecting you to throw in a spin there.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But this is Mr. Kijima's time to shine.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I should just do precisely what we practiced!)
se_run_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Kansuke
rows.Line:
“Even so...
Even so, I will choose this path...!”

rows.Speaker: Rokuro
rows.Line: “I see...”

rows.Speaker: Rokuro
rows.Line:
“Then, we have no choice but to fight.
Even if you are the only family I have left...!”

rows.Speaker: Kansuke
rows.Line: “Rokuro, I...”

rows.Speaker: Kansuke
rows.Line:
“I regret nothing.
I know we chose to go down different paths, but...”

rows.Speaker: Rokuro
rows.Line: “Yes, I also regret nothing. That is why...”

rows.Speaker: Rokuro
rows.Line: “I must be the one who ends you.”

rows.Speaker: Kansuke
rows.Line: “Yes, please do...”
After the show

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting it to end that way at all...! I mean, it started out kinda like a comedy...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: That was so good! I didn't know Mikazukigumi could put on shows that make your heart ache like that...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
I think the crowd liked what they saw!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That was the loudest applause we've heard...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even until the very last second, I kept learning from you. The audience really loved the way you improvised back there!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: And you did a good job of reacting, Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Thank you for being with us until today.
You've had a huge impact on this troupe. Myself included.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You might face some tough challenges when you set out into the world, but I'm sure you'll find a way to overcome all of them!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to the day you become a star.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm going to treasure every moment I spent training with everyone here at Mikazukigumi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You all encouraged me to chase after my dream. So, to make the most of what you've given me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will make my dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because I'm a future star!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Good!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Move forward with your head held high!
Go make your dream come true!
se_run_men_001_3

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Staff Member
rows.Line:
Mr. Kijima!
The venue staff said they'd all like to thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
I'll head right over. We'll talk again later, Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay!
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2
se_walk_men_001_3

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: (I wasn't able to draw out everything he had...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The way I moved on stage, including during that fight... I felt that I performed better than during practice.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But this is Mr. Kijima's time to shine.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I should just do precisely what we practiced!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Giving up the spotlight to him might've been a bit of a waste...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But at the end of the day, the show...)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You have to find the answer you're looking for on your own.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Wait a second... Is that what he meant by that?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I really do have a lot left to learn as an actor...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In order to put on the best performances imaginable, actors have to constantly give their all...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They'd all be laughing at me right now if they were here.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Speaking of which, Emu said that she wanted to throw a farewell party for Rui and me since we'll be leaving the country soon...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What would they say if they happened to be here to see today's show...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Emu would probably say, “It was so ridiculously amazingly explosively fun☆”. Nene would likely point out all the little mistakes in my movements.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And I imagine Rui would start coming up with a directing plan that includes a number of extra effects.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In any case, I would've been told I'm a fledgling with a lot left to learn.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I have to keep finding ways to grow...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As the troupe leader of Wonderlands×Showtime, I can't let them hog all the glory.)
